name: Lemony Salmon & Potato Traybake
description: Potatoes and green beans roast in the same tin as the salmon, so there's only one dish to wash. This file has prepTime and cookTime but no totalTime.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with half the oil, season and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the beans to the tin and nestle in the salmon. Top the fish with lemon slices and drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Roast for 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily. Squeeze over the lemon juice and scatter with capers and dill.
